votes.motion: Commissioner Duncan made a motion to forward a recommendation of approval to the Municipal Council of a full expansion of the Historic District (recommendation 3) for PC 25-049. There was no second made so the motion failed.

Commissioner Doutre made a motion to forward a recommendation of approval to the Municipal Council on the proposed Land Development Code Amendments specified within PC _25- 046 for Short Term Rentals, Beekeeping, Subdivisions, and Permit Extensions, while recommending the proposed minor subdivision lot numbers LDC 17.40 & 17.62 be reduced from 10 to 6, and denying all proposed changes to 17.10.060 (TC-1 Standards) with the findings for approval as listed below. Commissioner Lucero seconded the motion. The motion was approved unanimously.
extend the deadline on PC 23-005 for another year
